items.title: Laurence Juber interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: My friend Lee, Lee Newman, is the grandson of Jimmy McHugh, the songwriter.

ctx.x: I think I was watching when someone wrote in and said, “Well how many guitars do you own?” Answer?

I forget what I answered, as many as I need certainly. But the thing is that kind of this “Moody Monday,” “Wednesday Workshop” and “Finger Buster Friday” each one of those requires that I do work in advance. I kind of identify, okay, when a request comes in and I have to say okay is this something that I’ve already arranged and not played since I recorded it, and then have to revisit that, or is it something that I have to pull out of the hat as it were. But one of the things, you know I spent a lot of time…
Isolation booths have taken on an added meaning, yeah. So people who watch this are going to want to know, over your right shoulder is a shiny record and over your left shoulder —
